question: Can I tap creatures that came under my control this turn to pay for Sky Hussar's forecast ability?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you can tap any two untapped white and/or blue creatures you control, even ones you have not controlled continuously.
expected.answer: You can tap any two untapped white and/or blue creatures you control, including ones you haven't controlled continuously since the beginning of your most recent turn, to pay the cost of Sky Hussar's forecast ability.

whyHard: Tapping a creature as a cost usually needs it to have been under your control since the turn began, and players apply that rule here.
